Interface OfferTileAction

All Known Implementing Classes:
DrawCardsAction, TakeFoodAction
public interface OfferTileAction
Defines the contract for an action that can be performed on an offer tile. This interface abstracts different types of offer tile interactions using the Strategy pattern, allowing each action to define its own entry logic, card drawing constraints, and completion conditions. It also implements the Visitor pattern via the accept method for extensible processing.

  • Method Details

    • onEnterAction

      void onEnterAction(Player player, GameModel model)
      Called when a player enters this action on an offer tile.

      This method allows the action to perform initialization logic, such as displaying available cards or resetting state.

      Parameters:
      player - the player entering this action
      model - the current game model

    • canDraw

      boolean canDraw(Card card, RowsManager rowsManager)
      Determines whether a card can be drawn by the current player. This method enforces action-specific constraints on which cards are drawable given the current state of the rows' manager.
      Parameters:
      card - the card to evaluate for drawing
      rowsManager - the rows manager containing the card state
      Returns:
      true if the card can be drawn, false otherwise

    • performDraw

      void performDraw(Card card, RowsManager rowsManager)
      This method verify that the card can be drawn via canDraw(Card, RowsManager). If so, it updates currentTopRowDraws and currentBottomRowDraws DrawCardsAction attributes accordingly.
      Parameters:
      card - the card being drawn
      rowsManager - the rows manager to update with the draw

    • isFinished

      boolean isFinished()
      Determines whether this action has been completed.
      Returns:
      true if the action is finished and the offer tile interaction should end, false otherwise

    • accept

      void accept(OfferTileActionVisitor visitor)
      Accepts a visitor for processing this action.

      This method implements the Visitor pattern, allowing external logic to perform type-specific operations on different action implementations.

      Parameters:
      visitor - the visitor that will process this action
